produces.meaning: one named wire has been proven against evidence, not asserted

evidence.why: andon-verify is explicitly forbidden to write -- its SKILL.md says 'Never write to the ledger; andon-loop persists it', and its allowed-tools carry no Write. Nothing durable marks that one wire was proven.

requires.why: NOT compiled into a beat, deliberately. check_ingest_prereqs already enforces this in code and does it better: it checks BOTH MODERNIZATION_BRIEF.md and transform_brief_summary.json with os.path.isfile, and -- decisively -- only when gap_source == 'self-assess-brief'. A takt beat fires unconditionally, so it would deny andon-loop in its DEFAULT gap_source:self-scan mode, which needs no brief at all. Escapable only by TAKT_DISABLE_GUARD=1, which disables every other beat too.
